column1: # The manual says the BiSS C clock is 1 MHz. Akribis wrote on 2026-11-20 that it

column2: AGD156 compact servo drive with EtherCAT 3 Arms continuous
column3: 1 axis; EtherCAT + Ethernet; continuous 3 Arms; peak 9 Arms for 1.5 s; supply 1-phase 220 VAC (187 to 242 VAC); 0.95 kVA at 220 VAC; PWM 16 kHz; 1 encoder port (AqB + sin/cos + BiSS C + EnDat 2.2; BiSS C up to 32 bits); 8 isolated inputs; 4 isolated outputs; 4 differential I/O; 1 analog input 16 bit; 1 temperature input PT100 + PT1000 + thermostat; no brake output; regeneration output 3 A min 120 ohm; 2 safety inputs; size H 170 x W 40 x D 168 mm; IP20; 0 to 50 C
column10: Akribis (2026-11-20): reads BiSS C every 61 us (16 kHz); up to 32 bits; position loop closed every 62.5 us with interpolated EtherCAT CSP commands. No brake output: a vertical axis needs another drive or an external brake circuit. More: ../../docs/drive-questions.md in stoq-private.
